outputs.explanation: Panel A is a micrograph (pseudocoloured confocal images), not a plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B consists of line/scatter plots where individual measured intensity data points (green and red dots) are directly displayed over time, with fitted model curves overlaid. Since the individual data points themselves are shown (not just an average summary), and this is a scatter/line plot type, the check is satisfied.
